method: character 1-3-grams of space-padded words, the 500 most frequent per language (ties by code point order), as counts; no source text is stored
corpus: Unicode CLDR 48.2 locale data: common/main/<lang>.xml display names and labels, and common/annotations/<lang>.xml emoji names and keywords
udhr_not_used: unicode.org/udhr says: "Effective January 2024, the Unicode Consortium is no longer hosting the UDHR in Unicode project". The UN terms of use allow copies "for the User's personal, non-commercial use, without any right to resell or redistribute them or to compile or create derivative works therefrom". The successor project UDHR in XML (efele.net, github.com/eric-muller/udhr) has no licence, only "The UDHR and all its translations are obviously part of our commons." None is a clear permissive licence, so no UDHR text was used.
